columns.description: Customer classification of bill-to customer on source document line. Values are from the lookup CUSTOMER_CLASS. Value at source document line level takes precedence over value at source document level.

columns.name: L_UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure of inventory item or memo line on source document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of line sent from the source system. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE. Blank is equivalent to ORA_NEW_LINE.

columns.name: ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Specifies how a new line from the source system should be processed. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION. Blank is equivalent to ORA_ADD_TO_EXISTING_PO.

columns.name: INITIAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference key that identifies the parent source document line for the current line.

columns.name: TOP_PARENT_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference key that identifies the top most parent document line for the current line.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Source document line type for a project line. Possible values are ORIGINAL for initial baselined approved version, and REVISION for subsequent changes including changes to the revenue budget or for project status changed to closed.

columns.name: NET_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: PRICING_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the pricing dimension combination.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule identifier on source document line. Revenue scheduling rule determines the timing of revenue recognition.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_MODEL
columns.description: Specifies how satisfaction will be measured and recorded for a performance obligation line. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATIS_MEAS_MODEL.

columns.name: REVENUE_START_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recoginition start date for revenue rule types, such as daily revenue rate, all periods or daily revenue rate, and partial periods.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Number of periods in which revenue of this  performance obligation line is to be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_END_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recoginition end date for revenue rule types, such as daily revenue rate, all periods or daily revenue rate, and partial periods.

columns.name: LEDGER_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Ledger Currency code of customer contract. This value must match currency codes in Oracle Fusion General Ledger.

columns.name: ADD_TO_CONTRACT_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: List price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: COST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cost of inventory item or memo line. This column is used to calculate gross margin percent.

columns.name: MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if contract review should be queued for manual review. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Immaterial change type for this line. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_TYPE.

columns.name: CONTRACT_MODIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the revenue contract was modified.

columns.name: TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the revenue line was terminated.

columns.name: NET_QUANTITY
columns.description: Net quantity of a promised detail line.

columns.name: RECUR_LINE_COPY_NUM
columns.description: Sequence number of the recurring source document line.

columns.name: CONTRACT_GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Concatenation of the original customer contract's source document number and customer contract number for the recurring line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Source document group identifier used to group the initial recurring source document header and system-generated recurring source document headers. Value is the source document identifier for the original source document.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Original source document line identifier used to create the recurring source document line.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the rule type for the satisfaction plan of the source document line.

columns.name: RESIDUAL_APPROACH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the pricing for the goods or services is variable or missing and the standalone selling price for the resulting performance obligation is estimated using the residual approach. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Conversion date used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: LIST_PRICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: List price amount of the item or memo line

columns.name: PO_TEMPLATE_GROUPING_CODE
columns.description: Performance Obligation Template grouping code

columns.name: SERVICE_UOM
columns.description: Unit of measure of the service item on the source document line. Valid values are from the Price Periodicity UOM Class defined in Oracle Fusion Pricing.

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION
columns.description: Duration of the service item in terms of the service unit of measure.

columns.name: H_REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: The source document reference currency conversion rate date.

columns.name: L_REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: The source document line reference currency conversion rate date.

columns.name: REFERENCE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency used as the reference currency to convert entered currency amounts to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type used to convert entered currency amounts to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date used to convert entered currency amounts to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Rate used to convert entered currency amounts to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_CURR_DATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Date type used to convert entered currency amounts to the reference currency, Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_REF_CONVERSION_RATE_DATE.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIG_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Classification code of a performance obligation. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_OBLIG_CLASSIF_CODE.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: H_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Business unit identifier of source document.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CREDIT_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Measure of customer credit worthiness,Valid values are from the lookup type AR_CMGT_CREDIT_CLASSIFICATION.

columns.name: ASE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the additional satisfaction event rule.
